formulas.formula: Plan your whole wedding in one place: budget, vendors, guests, seating, checklist and gifts.
1. Wedding Details: your names, the date, the venue and your total budget.
2. Budget: your total is split by suggested % per category. Change the % to fit what matters to you.
3. Add each cost under Budget items (estimated, then actual) and each vendor on Vendors & Payments.
4. Guest List: one row per person. Track save the dates, invitations, RSVPs, meals and table numbers.
5. Seating Chart fills in from the table numbers on the Guest List.
6. Checklist: tasks dated from your wedding day. Tick them off as you go.
7. Gifts & Thank-Yous: never forget a thank-you note.
8. Dashboard: your countdown, budget, RSVPs, next tasks and next payments in one place.
Keep 5-10% of the budget for surprises: there are always a few.
Most catering bills are per guest, so the guest list drives the budget.
Note each deposit on Vendors & Payments so you always know what's left to pay.
Set an RSVP deadline 4-6 weeks before the wedding and follow up a week later.
Tinted cells: these calculate for you.
Green: done, paid, attending or under budget.
Yellow: coming up soon or pending.
Red: overdue, over budget, or something to check.
Congratulations, and thank you for your purchase! Enjoy every moment.
=IF('Wedding Details'!$L$5="","Add your wedding date on Wedding Details.",TEXT('Wedding Details'!$L$5,"dddd, mmmm d, yyyy")&IF(TRIM('Wedding Details'!C8&"")="",""," at "&'Wedding Details'!C8))
The basics. Everything else counts down to your date and splits your total budget.
Every checklist date counts back from this day.
What you can spend in all. It's split across the categories below.
Rename, add or change the % to fit your priorities. Shares should add up to 100%.
=IF(ROUND(C31,4)=1,"Adds up to 100%",IF(C31<1,"Still "&TEXT(1-C31,"0%")&" to give out",TEXT(C31-1,"0%")&" too much: lower some shares"))

One row per person (plus-ones and kids too). Tick save the dates and invitations as they go out, then fill in each RSVP, meal and table number.
Fills in from the table numbers on the Guest List. Set how many seats each table has.
